label: Inverted Pleated + Flap
description: An inverted-pleat patch breast pocket topped by a single flap is a classic Savile Row country-wear detail: the central inverted pleat allows the pocket to billow outward and hold a pocket square or notes with ease, while the flap adds a neat horizontal closure above the opening. It reads as sporting and purposeful without the visual complexity of twin flaps, and is frequently seen on tweed jackets, hacking coats, and stalking jackets where the pocket must be as practical as it is elegant.
